Around [[3999 BBY|four thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] lived in a '''compound''' on the desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. For a time, he lived there with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Oss Wilum]], and later with [[Nomi Sunrider]] while she [[Jedi training/Legends|learned]] the ways of the Jedi. The compound later became known as the '''Ambria Jedi Enclave''' to history.
